scope: One frozen combined-controller evaluation: 22 paired prior-failure regressions, 90 fresh near-floor tests across nine directions, and 16 prescribed standing releases. Same tilted-roof selection before and after side transfer; chosen front maneuver fixed before the fresh tests. All 24-second native paths, original final two-second standing gate, motor limits and failures retained. No automatic retry, new learning, strength qualification, sensor/terrain randomization or broad impact guarantee.
